tests.requirement: CREEPAGE DISTANCES and AIR CLEARANCES forming MEANS OF OPERATOR PROTECTION complying with IEC 60950-1 or IEC 62368-1:2018 for INSULATION CO-ORDINATION; equipment complying with IEC 62368-1:2018 for transient-free supply mains shall additionally comply with Table 13 to Table 16.
Specified min CLEARANCE applied as min CREEPAGE for CREEPAGE DISTANCES across glass, mica, ceramic and other inorganic insulating materials with similar tracking characteristics.
When min CREEPAGE derived from Tables 12 to 16 was less than min applicable CLEARANCE, value of min CLEARANCE applied as min CREEPAGE DISTANCE.
ME EQUIPMENT RATED to operate at an altitude of 2000 m.
ME EQUIPMENT RATED to operate at an altitude specified by MANUFACTURER.

Operating altitude corresponding to actual air pressure for ME EQUIPMENT intended for pressurized environments used to determine multiplication factor from Table 8, and AIR CLEARANCE multiplied by this factor.
CREEPAGE DISTANCES not subjected to multiplication factors, but were at least as large as the resulting value for AIR CLEARANCE.
When WORKING VOLTAGE was between those in Tables 12 to 16, CREEPAGE and CLEARANCES calculated by linear interpolation.
CREEPAGE DISTANCES determined by linear interpolation between nearest two values, calculated spacing rounded off to next higher 0.1 mm increment.
CLEARANCES for PEAK WORKING VOLTAGES above 2800 V peak or d.c. determined by linear interpolation between nearest two values, rounded off to next higher 0.1 mm increment.
For AIR CLEARANCES corresponding to PEAK WORKING VOLTAGE up to 2800 V peak or d.c., the higher of the two values applied.
Material groups classified in accordance with Table 9 (Material Group).
Material group evaluated using 50 drops of solution A based on test data for material according to IEC 60112.
Material of unknown group considered IIIb.
Pollution degree 1: Micro-environment sealed to exclude dust and moisture.
Pollution degree 2: Micro-environment with non-conductive pollution, except occasional conductivity caused by condensation.
Pollution degree 3: Micro-environment subject to conductive pollution, or dry non-conductive pollution that could become conductive due to expected condensation.
Pollution degree 4: Micro-environment where continuous conductivity occurs due to conductive dust, rain, or other wet conditions.
Pollution degree 4 not used for insulation providing a MEANS OF PROTECTION.
Where insulation between MAINS PART and earth might be compromised, measures such as maintenance ensure micro-environment is mitigated to a lower pollution degree.
Means employed according to Annex M to reduce the pollution degree.
Overvoltage category classification; value of MAINS TRANSIENT VOLTAGE determined from overvoltage category per IEC60664-1 and NOMINAL a.c. MAINS VOLTAGE using Table 10.
V Peak (V) (VMT).
V r.m.s (V) (VMN).

AIR CLEARANCE for MAINS PARTS (operating on RATED MAINS VOLTAGES up to 300 V) were values for r.m.s. or d.c. RATED MAINS VOLTAGE in Table 13 plus additional CLEARANCE in Table 14 for PEAK WORKING VOLTAGE.
SUPPLY MAINS overvoltage category II applied according to IEC 60664-1.

semantic_fragments.content: 绝缘配合测试中，材料组别按照Table 9分类为IIIb级；未知组别材料同样视为IIIb级处理。污染等级评定为2级（非导电性污染的微环境，偶尔因冷凝引起的导电性除外）。爬电距离与空气间隙的计算：当工作电压介于表格列出的数值之间时，通过线性插值确定，并向上取整到0.1mm精度；峰值工作电压不超过2800V峰值或直流时，取两相邻值中的较大值作为空气间隙。绝缘图（Insulation Diagram）中记录了具体爬电距离计算值。
